import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='JUNpaMa'].copy()

# Fit per-resource seasonal model (weekday x week-of-series) using data excluding Oct13-18, predict Oct16
normal = a[~a.instance_family.isin(['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG'])]
anom_fams = a[a.instance_family.isin(['fG8wYOz6XO','g9c1yzr6KG'])]

def resid_summary(sub):
    sub = sub.copy()
    start = sub.date.min()
    sub['week'] = ((sub.date - start).dt.days//7)
    sub['wd'] = sub.date.dt.dayofweek
    # exclude target day and neighbors Oct13-18 for fitting
    fitmask = ~sub.date.between('2025-10-13','2025-10-18')
    piv = sub.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).apply(lambda g: None)
    res = []
    for k,g in sub.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']):
        gf = g[fitmask]
        if len(gf)<10 or g.date.eq(pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')).sum()==0: continue
        m = gf.groupby(['week','wd']).unblended_cost.mean()
        tgt = g[g.date=='2025-10-16'].unblended_cost.iloc[0]
        wdw = ((pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')-start).days//7, pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16').dayofweek)
        pred = m.get(wdw, np.nan)
        if not np.isnan(pred):
            res.append((k, pred, tgt, tgt-pred))
    r = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['key','pred','actual','excess']).set_index('key')
    return r.sort_values('excess', ascending=False)

rn = resid_summary(normal)
print("Normal resources top excesses:"); print(rn.head(8)); print("total normal excess:", rn.excess.sum())
ra = resid_summary(anom_fams)
print("\nCandidate families:"); print(ra)
